Houston homeowners should act quickly when a pipe breaks to reduce water damage to walls, flooring, furniture and other property areas.
Professional plumbers inspect the damaged pipe, stop the water flow and recommend the correct repair or replacement solution.

sections.title: Emergency Water Leak Repair Houston TX
content: Water leaks can happen inside walls, ceilings, floors, underground pipes and plumbing fixtures.

tips: Check for unexpected water stains on walls or ceilings.
